description: Process deferred improvement tasks created from failed activity executions

task_steps.title: Load Task Context
task_steps.description: Retrieve and analyze the boredom task details and associated debug data
guidance: Load the full task context including failure reason and debug data
Review metabob annotations captured at time of failure
Understand what the original activity was trying to accomplish
Identify the specific failure point in the execution flow

task_steps.title: Analyze Root Cause
task_steps.description: Determine the underlying cause of the failure using debug data
guidance: Review the captured logs and stack trace
Analyze the execution steps to find where things went wrong
Check environment variables for configuration issues
Look for patterns that might indicate systemic problems
Consider if the failure was due to missing context, unclear guidance, or code issues

task_steps.title: Evaluate Suggested Actions
task_steps.description: Review and prioritize the automatically suggested actions
guidance: Assess each suggested action for feasibility and impact
Prioritize actions by confidence score and expected improvement
Consider if multiple actions should be combined
Identify any additional actions not suggested automatically
Validate that suggested file paths and targets are correct

task_steps.title: Implement the Fix
task_steps.description: Make the necessary changes to resolve the issue
guidance: For template-update tasks: Modify the activity template JSON
For validator-check tasks: Update validation rules to match expected behavior
For data-flow-test tasks: Fix connection or API issues
For code-robustness tasks: Add error handling and edge case coverage
For metric-calibration tasks: Update expected metrics based on actuals
For guidance-refinement tasks: Improve task guidance clarity
Document what changes were made and why

task_steps.title: Validate the Fix
task_steps.description: Ensure the fix resolves the original issue without introducing new problems
guidance: Run any relevant tests or validation commands
Check that the modified files have valid syntax
Verify the fix addresses the root cause identified earlier
Consider edge cases that might be affected by the change
Ensure no sensitive data was accidentally exposed

task_steps.title: Record Outcome
task_steps.description: Document the fix and record metrics for future learning
guidance: Complete the boredom task with success/failure status
List all changes that were applied
Note any tests that were run and their results
Add any relevant notes for future reference
If the fix revealed additional issues, create follow-up boredom tasks
